title: Docs: deciding an in-app AI pending action takes the person's own session — the skill, client-sdk.mdx and the pendingActions docblock still teach the token route
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYK6SZCmyzbGnrvmkk

Filing gate: ② a declared follow-up with no carrier. The changeset of #34001 declares `Skills-docs: follow-up` for these three places and says it "moves with the change that implements the in-app door". That change is objectstack-ai/cloud#4607 (card #33809), whose contract review named the missing carrier as a should-fix. Dedupe: `pendingActions` docs, `ai:approve deciding` return no open card.
Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#4607 names this card in its PR body.

## 维护者速读

- 要做的：把技能文档、`client-sdk.mdx` 和 `client.ai.pendingActions` 的注释改成：批准或拒绝应用内待批动作，只能由本人用自己的会话来做。
- 为什么：ADR-0087 `in-app-pending-action-decided-by-person` 在 cloud#4607 落地后，这三处还在教用令牌或 SDK 调用决定路由，照着做会得到 403。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Change

1. `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md:166`: the paragraph on how an operator approves or rejects a held action says deciding is the person's own act from the console (their signed-in session), and drops the `GET/POST /api/v1/ai/pending-actions/...` call as a way to decide. Listing stays as written.
2. `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx:426`: "deciding takes `ai:approve`" says deciding also takes the person's own session; an SDK client on a token can list but not decide.
3. The `client.ai.pendingActions` approve/reject docblock says the same.
4. Land it in the same release window as the cloud pin bump that carries objectstack-ai/cloud#4607, or after; not before.
5. Done when the three places agree with ADR-0087's rule and `check:all` passes.
